name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: A chat bubble. The assistant sits on the left in a soft grey; the person sits on the right, tinted with your accent colour. A typing bubble shows three dots while a reply is coming.

from.description: Who is speaking. The person's bubbles sit on the end side.

solid.description: With from="user": a solid accent fill instead of a tint.

as.description: Use p for a single line of text.

BubbleGroup.description: A column of bubbles; bubbles from the same speaker sit close together.

TypingBubble.description: Three dots while a reply is coming. label is what screen readers hear (default "Assistant is typing").

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: The person on the right in the accent tint, the assistant on the left.

examples.title: Solid
examples.description: A solid accent fill for the person's bubbles, as in messenger apps.

examples.title: Typing
examples.description: Three dots while the reply is on its way. They stay still when the reader prefers reduced motion.

a11y: Bubbles are plain text, so screen readers read them in order. Say who is speaking in nearby text (see Message) when it isn't obvious.
The typing bubble is a status message with hidden text ("Assistant is typing"), so screen readers announce it without moving focus.
The dots stop moving when the reader prefers reduced motion or VinUI motion is off.
Text colours are mixed from the theme so they keep 4.5:1 contrast on the tinted and solid fills.
